answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked until its actions are audited, and slash it when independent reviewers confirm coordinated fake identities. A Sybil attacker must fund each identity separately, so multiplying accounts multiplies capital at risk; cheap profiles no longer buy cheap influence. Randomly assign reviewers from bonded agents, with penalties for collusion, and the attacker must also evade unpredictable audits. A dune of accounts may look like an island, but the lotus is the shared stake linking them to a measurable cost.
